assessment_summary: The statement claims that deterministic Quicksort using the first element as pivot with Lomuto partition runs in O(n log n) time on all inputs, citing an already-sorted array as a "cheap case". This is false. On an already-sorted array, the first element is the minimum. The partition step compares the pivot with the remaining n-1 elements and places the pivot at the first position. This leaves a subproblem of size n-1 (and an empty subproblem of size 0). This results in the worst-case recurrence relation T(n) = T(n-1) + (n-1), which resolves to T(n) = Theta(n^2) comparisons. Therefore, the running time on already-sorted arrays is not O(n log n).
counterexample: The infinite family of already-sorted arrays: A_n = [1, 2, 3, ..., n] for each n.
